verdict.rationale: Poly documents an official hosted MCP server at https://mcp.poly.app/mcp, using streamable HTTP with in-browser OAuth. The official Claude Code plugin connects that server, and the docs index covers MCP setup for Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Gemini and IDEs. A runtime probe confirmed the endpoint is live and returns the MCP OAuth challenge. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of an authenticated session actually calling the exposed tools (search, fetch, virtual CLI), and independent community reports of using the MCP server.
